en.t: Alfonso VII succeeds Urraca in León and Castile
en.s: On March 8, 1126, Alfonso VII succeeded his mother, Queen Urraca, after her death. His coronation in León took place on March 10.
en.n: Succession and coronation took place on different days.

zh.t: 阿方索七世继承莱昂和卡斯蒂利亚王位
zh.s: 1126年3月8日，乌拉卡女王去世，儿子阿方索七世继位。他于3月10日在莱昂加冕。
zh.n: 继位与加冕发生在不同日期。

en.s: The Battle of Hausbergen (or Battle of Oberhausbergen) was a historic military engagement that took place in the Alsace region of northeastern France on 8 March 1262. The battle marked the release of the 'burghers' (citizens) of Strasbourg from episcopal authority and gave the bourgeoisie control over politics and commerce. The battle occurred on the fields of Hausbergen, an area of countryside a few miles northwest of the city of Strasbourg.

zh.s: 豪斯贝尔根战役又称上豪斯贝尔根战役，于1262年3月8日在今法国东北部阿尔萨斯地区发生。战场位于斯特拉斯堡城西北几英里的豪斯贝尔根乡间田野。此战使斯特拉斯堡市民摆脱了主教的统治，由市民阶层掌握政治和商业权力。

en.s: The Siege of Chittorgarh was a military campaign launched by Sultan Bahadur Shah of Gujarat Sultanate against the fortress of Chittor, capital of the Kingdom of Mewar under Rana Vikramaditya. The conflicts witnessed two successive sieges between 1533 and 1535, leading to the fort's capture on 8 March 1535 by the Gujarati army. Following the collapse of the Malwa Sultanate, rivalry over its territories ended earlier friendly ties between Gujarat Sultanate and Kingdom of Mewar.

zh.t: 古吉拉特军队攻占奇托尔堡
zh.s: 奇托尔堡围城战是古吉拉特苏丹国苏丹巴哈杜尔·沙阿针对奇托尔堡发动的军事行动。奇托尔堡是梅瓦尔王国的首都，当时由拉纳·维克拉玛蒂亚统治。1533年至1535年间，双方先后两次围城；1535年3月8日，古吉拉特军队攻占该堡。马尔瓦苏丹国覆灭后，古吉拉特苏丹国和梅瓦尔王国因争夺其领土而反目，此前的友好关系也随之结束。

en.s: The Spanish expedition to Tlemcen, also known as Tlemcen War was led by Count Alcaudete between 27 January and 8 March 1543 with the aim of overthrowing the Zayyanid king Abu Zayyan III and replacing him with Abu Abdallah VI. The expedition was successful and Abu Abdallah was restored to the throne as a Spanish vassal.

zh.t: 西班牙远征特莱姆森（1543年）
zh.s: 阿尔考德特伯爵于1543年1月27日至3月8日率领西班牙军队远征特莱姆森，又称特莱姆森战争，目标是推翻宰扬王朝国王阿布·宰扬三世，并让阿布·阿卜杜拉六世继位。远征取得成功，阿布·阿卜杜拉复位，成为西班牙的附庸。

en.s: The Blockade of the Tetuan River (Spanish: Jornada del Rio de Tetuán) on 8 March 1565 was a successful Spanish blockade of the Tetuan River (present-day Martil river) against the Saadi Sultanate. The Spanish forces were led by Álvaro de Bazán, Alonso de Bazán and Esteban de Guillisastegui, who was wounded during the operation.

zh.s: 1565年3月8日，西班牙针对萨阿德苏丹国，在得土安河（今马尔提勒河）成功实施封锁。西班牙语中，这次行动称为‘得土安河远征’。西军由阿尔瓦罗·德·巴赞、阿隆索·德·巴赞和埃斯特班·德·吉利萨斯特吉指挥，吉利萨斯特吉在行动中负伤。

en.s: The Treaty of Roskilde was negotiated at the parsonage of Høje Taastrup Church and was concluded on 26 February (OS) or 8 March 1658 (NS) in the Danish city of Roskilde during the Second Northern War between Frederick III of Denmark–Norway and Karl X Gustav of Sweden. After a devastating defeat, Denmark–Norway was forced to give up a third of its territory to save the rest, the ceded lands comprising Blekinge, Bornholm, Bohuslän, Scania and Trøndelag, as well as Halland.

zh.s: 罗斯基勒条约在丹麦罗斯基勒谈判，并于1658年3月8日（新历；旧历2月26日）签署，结束了第二次北方战争。丹麦—挪威在惨败后被迫割让三分之一领土，以保住其余领地；割让地区包括布莱金厄、博恩霍尔姆、布胡斯、斯科讷、特伦德拉格和哈兰。

en.s: Queen Anne's War (1702–1713) was the second in a series of French and Indian Wars fought in North America involving the colonial empires of Great Britain, France, and Spain. In the United States, it is regarded as a standalone conflict. Elsewhere it is viewed as the American theater of the War of the Spanish Succession. It is also known as the Third Indian War.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 安妮女王战争（1702—1713年）是北美一系列法国—印第安战争中的第二场，交战方为英国、法国和西班牙的殖民帝国。在美国，这场战争被视为一场独立冲突；在其他地区，它被视为西班牙王位继承战争在美洲的战事。它也称第三次印第安战争。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的战争开始日期。

en.t: Anne succeeds William III as queen
en.s: On March 8, 1702, Anne succeeded William III upon his death, becoming Queen of England, Scotland and Ireland. Her coronation followed on April 23.
en.n: March 8 is the Old Style Julian date, with the year numbered from January 1. This records her accession, not her coronation.

zh.t: 安妮继承威廉三世的王位
zh.s: 1702年3月8日，威廉三世去世，安妮继位，成为英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰女王。她的加冕典礼于4月23日举行。
zh.n: 3月8日为当时使用的儒略历日期，年份按1月1日开始计算。这里记录继位，并非加冕。

en.s: The Battle of Gulnabad (Sunday, March 8, 1722) was fought between the military forces from Hotaki Dynasty and the army of the Safavid Empire. It further cemented the eventual fall of the Safavid dynasty, which had been declining for decades.

zh.s: 古尔纳巴德战役于1722年3月8日星期日发生，交战双方为霍塔克王朝军队与萨法维帝国军队。这场战役进一步促成了已衰落数十年的萨法维王朝最终覆亡。

en.t: Nader Shah is crowned on the Mughan plain
en.s: On March 8, 1736, Nader was crowned shah on the Mughan plain after an assembly of leaders accepted him as ruler. His accession displaced the Safavid dynasty and established Afsharid rule.
en.n: The Mughan plain spans present-day Azerbaijan and Iran. A precise modern-country location has not yet been confirmed for this record.

zh.t: 纳迪尔在穆甘平原加冕为沙阿
zh.s: 1736年3月8日，纳迪尔在穆甘平原加冕为沙阿。此前，与会首领已同意拥立他为统治者。他的登基取代了萨法维王朝，建立阿夫沙尔王朝的统治。
zh.n: 穆甘平原横跨今天的阿塞拜疆和伊朗，本条记录的具体地点尚待进一步确认。

en.s: On March 8, 1775, the Pennsylvania Journal published “African Slavery in America”, an essay opposing slavery and the slave trade. It was later attributed to Thomas Paine, but that attribution is disputed.
en.n: The publication date is supported; the author’s identity remains disputed.

zh.t: 反奴隶制文章《美洲的非洲奴隶制》发表
zh.s: 1775年3月8日，《宾夕法尼亚日报》刊登《美洲的非洲奴隶制》，反对奴隶制和奴隶贸易。这篇文章后来被认为出自托马斯·潘恩之手，但作者归属存在争议。
zh.n: 发表日期有来源支持，作者身份仍有争议。

en.s: The Skirmish at Waters Creek was a minor action fought on March 8, 1781, during the American Revolutionary War. It was fought near Waters Creek in Newport News, Virginia between a group of local Patriot militia and British Army troops.

zh.s: 1781年3月8日，美国独立战争期间，沃特斯溪发生了一场小规模战斗。交战双方是当地爱国者民兵和英国陆军，战场位于弗吉尼亚州纽波特纽斯附近。

en.s: The Gnadenhutten massacre, also known as the Moravian massacre, was the killing of 96 Christian Lenape (Delaware) by colonial American militia from Pennsylvania on March 8, 1782 at the Moravian missionary village of Gnadenhutten, Ohio during the American Revolutionary War. The site of the village has been preserved. A reconstructed mission house and cooper's house were built there, and a monument to the dead was erected and dedicated a century later. The burial mound is marked and has been maintained on the site. The village site has been listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

zh.s: 1782年3月8日，美国独立战争期间，来自宾夕法尼亚的殖民地民兵在俄亥俄的摩拉维亚教会传教村格纳登许滕杀害了96名信奉基督教的莱纳佩人（又称特拉华人）。这起事件也称‘摩拉维亚大屠杀’。村庄遗址得到保护，传教所和制桶匠的房屋得以重建。屠杀发生一百年后，当地竖立并揭幕了死难者纪念碑。遗址上的合葬土丘设有标记，并一直受到维护。该村遗址已列入美国《国家史迹名录》。

en.s: The 1785 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on March 8, 1785, in order to elect the President of New Hampshire. (The office would be renamed to Governor in 1792.) Candidates consisted of John Langdon, George Atkinson, John Sullivan and Josiah Bartlett. Since no candidate received a majority in the popular vote, Langdon was elected by the New Hampshire General Court per the state constitution, despite having come in second in the popular vote.

en.s: The action of 8 March 1795 was a minor naval engagement in the Mediterranean theatre of the French Revolutionary Wars. The action was part of series of battles fought in the spring of 1795 between British and French fleets for control of the Ligurian Sea and thus the blockade of the French naval base of Toulon.

zh.s: 1795年3月8日，法国大革命战争地中海战区发生一场小规模海战。这是1795年春季英国和法国舰队争夺利古里亚海控制权的一系列战斗之一，双方争夺的目的包括封锁法国海军基地土伦。

en.s: The Battle of Abukir of 8 March 1801 was the second pitched battle of the French invasion of Egypt and Syria to be fought at Abu Qir on the Mediterranean coast, near the Nile Delta. The landing of the British expeditionary force under Lieutenant-General Sir Ralph Abercromby was intended to defeat or drive out an estimated 21,000 remaining French troops in Egypt.

zh.s: 1801年3月8日，法军入侵埃及和叙利亚期间，在地中海沿岸尼罗河三角洲附近的阿布基尔，与英军进行第二次大型会战。拉尔夫·阿伯克龙比中将率领的英国远征军登陆，意在击败或驱逐仍留在埃及的约21,000名法军。

en.s: The Siege of Bergen op Zoom (8 March 1814), took place during the War of the Sixth Coalition between a British force led by Thomas Graham, 1st Baron Lynedoch and a French garrison under Guilin Laurent Bizanet and Jean-Jacques Ambert. The initial British assault force seized part of the defenses, but a well-managed French counterattacked and compelled much of the assault force to surrender. Bergen op Zoom is a port in the Netherlands about 70 kilometres (43 mi) south of Rotterdam and 40 kilometres (25 mi) north of Antwerp in Belgium.

zh.s: 贝亨奥普佐姆围攻战于1814年3月8日发生，是第六次反法同盟战争的一场战斗。英军由第一代林多克男爵托马斯·格雷厄姆率领，法军守军由吉兰·洛朗·比扎内和让-雅克·安贝尔指挥。英军突击部队起初夺取了部分防御工事，但法军组织反击，迫使大部分突击部队投降。贝亨奥普佐姆是荷兰的一座港口，位于鹿特丹以南约70公里（43英里）、比利时安特卫普以北约40公里（25英里）。

en.s: The Battle of Hampton Roads, often referred to as either the Battle of the Monitor and Merrimack (or Virginia) or the Battle of Ironclads, was the most noted and arguably most important naval battle of the American Civil War from the standpoint of the development of navies. It was fought over two days, March 8–9, 1862, in Hampton Roads, a roadstead in Virginia where the Elizabeth and Nansemond rivers meet the James River just before it enters Chesapeake Bay adjacent to the city of Norfolk.

zh.s: 汉普顿锚地海战也常称为‘监视者号与梅里马克号（或弗吉尼亚号）之战’或‘铁甲舰之战’。从海军发展的角度看，它是美国内战中最著名、也可以说最重要的海战。战斗于1862年3月8日至9日在弗吉尼亚州汉普顿锚地持续两天。这里紧邻诺福克市，伊丽莎白河与南塞蒙德河在此汇入詹姆斯河，后者随即流入切萨皮克湾。

zh.s: 瓦埃勒战役于1864年3月8日在瓦埃勒镇内及周边发生，是第二次石勒苏益格战争中奥地利帝国与丹麦之间的一场战斗。奥军获胜，为随后弗雷德里西亚撤退和亚斯蒙德海战的发生铺平了道路。

en.s: The Sakai incident (堺事件, Sakai Jiken) was a diplomatic incident that occurred on March 8, 1868, in Bakumatsu period Japan involving the deaths of eleven French sailors from the French corvette Dupleix in the port of Sakai near Osaka, Japan. It is also known as the Senshū Sakai incident (泉州堺事件) or the Myōkoku-ji incident (妙国寺事件), and was one of three major diplomatic incidents involving attacks on foreigners in Japan in 1868, the others being the Kobe Incident and the attempted assassination of Harry Parkes.

en.s: In the 1892 Quebec general election on March 8, 1892, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The incumbent Quebec Conservative Party, led by Charles-Eugène Boucher de Boucherville, defeated the Quebec Liberal Party, led by Félix-Gabriel Marchand. Mercier had been accused of corruption and removed from office as Premier by Quebec Lieutenant-governor Auguste-Réal Angers on December 16, 1891.

en.s: The North Tyrone by-election of 1907 was held on 8 March 1907. The by-election was held due to the incumbent Liberal MP, William Huston Dodd, being appointed as a Judge of the High Court of Justice in Ireland 1907-24. It was narrowly won by the Liberal candidate Redmond John Barry in a very high turnout.

en.s: General elections to the Cortes Generales were held in Spain on 8 March 1914. At stake were all 408 seats in the Congress of Deputies. Though formally competitive, the 1914 general election was held under the customary system of Turno Pacifico; in accordance with a long-standing power-sharing arrangement, elections (under influence by machine bosses called caciques) served as a rubber stamp for a routine handover of power initiated by the King. The 1914 election, as expected, sanctioned the pre-arranged handover from the Liberals to the Conservatives.

zh.s: 西班牙于1914年3月8日举行议会大选，改选众议院全部408个席位。选举形式上存在竞争，实际上仍沿用‘和平轮流执政’制度。按照长期的权力分享安排，由国王发起例行的权力交接，选举则在地方政治头目操控下，为既定安排盖章。此次选举也如预期，认可了事先安排好的自由党向保守党的权力移交。

en.s: The Battle of Dujaila (Turkish: Sâbis Muharebesi) was fought on 8 March 1916, between British and Ottoman forces during the First World War. The Ottoman forces, led by Colmar Freiherr von der Goltz were besieging Kut, when the Anglo-Indian relief force, led by Lieutenant-General Fenton Aylmer, attempted to relieve the city. The attempt failed, and Aylmer lost 4,000 men.

zh.s: 杜贾拉战役于1916年3月8日发生，是第一次世界大战期间英军与奥斯曼军队之间的一场战斗，土耳其语中称为‘萨比斯战役’。科尔马·冯·德·戈尔茨男爵率领的奥斯曼军队正在围攻库特，芬顿·艾尔默中将率领英属印度援军试图为该城解围。行动失败，艾尔默所部损失4,000人。

en.s: The 1917 Hawkes Bay by-election was a by-election held in the eastern North Island electorate of Hawkes Bay during the 19th New Zealand Parliament, on 8 March 1917. It was caused by the death of incumbent MP Robert McNab, and was won by fellow party Liberal Party member Sir John Findlay with a majority of 471 votes.

zh.s: 1917年3月8日，新西兰第19届议会任期内，北岛东部的霍克斯湾选区举行补选。补选由现任议员罗伯特·麦克纳布去世引起。他的自由党同僚约翰·芬德利爵士以领先471票的优势胜出。

en.s: The Romanian military intervention in Bessarabia took place between 19 January and 8 March (Old Style [O.S.] 5 January – 23 February) 1918, as part of the broader Allied intervention in the Russian Civil War. It pitted the Kingdom of Romania, Russian Republic, Ukrainian People's Republic and anti-Bolshevik factions of the Moldavian Democratic Republic on one side, against the Bolshevik controlled Rumcherod and Odessa Soviet Republic, as well as pro-Bolshevik factions within the Moldavian DR.

en.t: The Anfu Club is formed in China
en.s: On March 8, 1918, the Anfu Club was formed from the Zhonghe Club in China. Xu Shuzheng helped organise it with Wang Yitang and other politicians associated with Duan Qirui.

en.t: Spanish Prime Minister Eduardo Dato Iradier is assassinated while on his way home from the parliament building in Madrid
en.s: Eduardo Dato e Iradier (12 August 1856 – 8 March 1921) was a Spanish political leader during the Spanish Restoration period. He served three times as Spanish prime minister: from 27 October 1913 to 9 December 1915, from 11 June 1917 to 3 November 1917, and from 28 April 1920 until his assassination by Catalan anarchists. He also held eleven cabinet ministries, and was four times president of the Spanish Congress of Deputies.

zh.t: 西班牙首相爱德华多·达托从议会大厦返家途中遇刺身亡
zh.s: 爱德华多·达托·伊拉迪耶（1856年8月12日—1921年3月8日）是西班牙复辟时期的政治领袖，曾三度担任首相：1913年10月27日至1915年12月9日、1917年6月11日至11月3日，以及1920年4月28日起直至被加泰罗尼亚无政府主义者刺杀。他还担任过11个内阁部门的负责人，并四次出任西班牙众议院议长。

en.s: The Castle Gate mine disaster occurred on March 8, 1924, in a coal mine near the town of Castle Gate, Utah (now dismantled), located approximately 90 miles (140 km) southeast of Salt Lake City. All of the 171 men working in the mine were killed in the series of three violent explosions. One worker, the leader of the rescue crew, died from carbon monoxide inhalation while attempting to reach the victims shortly after the explosion. At least 24 out of the mine's 25 mules died in the explosion, along with an unknown number of horses and canaries.

zh.s: 1924年3月8日，犹他州卡斯尔盖特镇附近的一座煤矿发生矿难。该镇位于盐湖城东南约90英里（140公里），后来已被拆除。连续三次猛烈爆炸使井下作业的171人全部遇难。爆炸发生不久，一名带领救援队的工人在试图接近遇难者时吸入一氧化碳身亡。矿上的25头骡子至少有24头死于爆炸，另有数量不明的马和金丝雀死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Guadalajara (8–23 March 1937) saw the victory of the Spanish Republican Army (Ejército Popular Republicano, or EPR) and of the International Brigades over the Italian and Nationalist forces attempting to encircle Madrid during the Spanish Civil War. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Sudan on 27 February and 8 March 1958.The first elections since independence in 1956, they were supposed to be held in August 1957, but were postponed by the ruling council, who claimed that flooding would affect the vote. The result was a victory for the Umma Party, which won 63 of the 173 seats. The Southern Sudan Federal Party competed in the election, and won 40 of the 46 seats allocated to the southern provinces.The party platform represented a serious challenge to the authorities.However, when it became clear that the party's demands for a federal structure would be ignored by the Constituent Assembly, on 16 June 1958 the southern MPs left parliament.

zh.s: 苏丹于1958年2月27日和3月8日举行议会选举，这是该国1956年独立后的首次选举。投票原定于1957年8月举行，但执政委员会以洪水会影响投票为由将其推迟。民族党赢得173席中的63席，取得胜利。南苏丹联邦党也参加了选举，拿下分配给南部各省的46席中的40席，其政治主张对当局构成重大挑战。不过，当该党发现制宪议会将不理会其建立联邦体制的要求后，南部议员于1958年6月16日退出议会。

en.t: 1962 Taurus Mountains Turkish Airlines F-27 crash
en.s: On 8 March 1962, a Fairchild F-27 of Turkish Airlines crashed into Mount Medetsiz in the Taurus Mountains range while en route from Ankara Esenboğa Airport to Adana Airport, killing all eight passengers and three crew members on board. zh.s: 苏联民航513号班机是从苏联古比雪夫机场飞往索契国际机场的国内定期客运航班，中途停靠顿河畔罗斯托夫机场。1965年3月8日，一架执飞该航线的图-124客机从古比雪夫机场起飞后不久坠毁，机上30名乘客和机组人员遇难，另有9人幸存。这是图-124客机发生的首起致命事故。

en.t: Nelson's Pillar in Dublin, Ireland, is destroyed by a bomb
en.s: Nelson's Pillar (also known as the Nelson Pillar or simply the Pillar) was a large granite column capped by a statue of Horatio Nelson, built in the centre of what was then Sackville Street (later renamed O'Connell Street) in Dublin, Ireland. zh.t: 都柏林纳尔逊纪念柱被炸毁
zh.s: 纳尔逊纪念柱也称纳尔逊柱，简称纪念柱，是一座大型花岗岩圆柱，顶部立有霍雷肖·纳尔逊雕像。它建在都柏林萨克维尔街（后更名为奥康奈尔街）市中心，于1809年竣工，当时爱尔兰仍属联合王国。纪念柱一直保留到1966年3月，随后被爱尔兰共和派安放的炸药严重炸毁。

en.t: Churachandpur election result declares Lalroukung elected
en.s: On March 8, 1967, Lalroukung was declared elected to Manipur’s legislative assembly from Churachandpur constituency in India. The election was later challenged in court, so this entry records the declaration rather than the final outcome of that litigation.
en.n: This is the declaration of a constituency result, not a statewide polling date.

zh.t: 丘拉昌普尔选区公布结果，拉尔鲁孔获宣布当选
zh.s: 1967年3月8日，拉尔鲁孔获宣布当选印度曼尼普尔议会的丘拉昌普尔选区议员。这次选举后来受到诉讼挑战，此条记录的是当选结果公布，并非诉讼的最终结论。
zh.n: 这是具体选区公布结果的日期，并非全境统一的投票日期。

en.s: Elections to the Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly were held in March 1972. These were the elections to the legislative assembly having 296 seats in undivided Madhya Pradesh. The Indian National Congress won a majority of seats and Prakash Chandra Sethi was sworn in as the new Chief Minister. After the 1962 Madhya Pradesh Legislative Assembly election, the number of constituencies in Madhya Pradesh were increased to 296, following the recommendation of the Delimitation Commission of India.

zh.s: 1972年3月，中央邦举行立法议会选举，选出未分治的中央邦议会296个席位的议员。印度国民大会党赢得多数席位，普拉卡什·钱德拉·塞蒂宣誓就任新任首席部长。此前的1962年中央邦议会选举后，根据印度划界委员会的建议，该邦选区数增至296个。

en.s: The 4th Gujarat Legislative Assembly election was held in 1972. Indian National Congress won 140 seats out of 168 seats. While, NCO won 16 seats. Congress performed better in this election and gained 47 seats. Total of 852 men and 21 women contested the election. Total 167 men and 1 woman won in the elections. The number of polling stations was 17,994 and the number of electors per polling station was 695.

zh.t: 1972年古吉拉特邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 1972年举行的第四届古吉拉特邦立法议会选举中，印度国民大会党赢得168席中的140席，国大党（组织）赢得16席。国大党表现更好，席位增加47席。共有852名男性和21名女性候选人参选，其中167名男性和1名女性当选。全邦设有17,994个投票站，平均每个投票站对应695名选民。
zh.n: 此条采用原文资料框列出的事件日期。

en.t: Opening of Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport
en.s: Paris Charles de Gaulle Airport (IATA: CDG, ICAO: LFPG), also known as Roissy Airport, is the primary international airport serving Paris, the capital of France. The airport opened in 1974 and is located in Roissy-en-France, 23 km (14 mi) northeast of the city centre of Paris. It is named after World War II leader and French president Charles de Gaulle, whose initials form its IATA airport code.

zh.s: 巴黎戴高乐机场（IATA代码：CDG；ICAO代码：LFPG），也称鲁瓦西机场，是服务法国首都巴黎的主要国际机场。机场于1974年开放，位于巴黎市中心东北方向23公里处的鲁瓦西昂法兰西。机场以二战领导人、法国总统夏尔·戴高乐命名，IATA代码CDG取自其姓名缩写。

en.t: Reagan delivers his “Evil Empire” speech in Orlando
en.s: On March 8, 1983, U.S. President Ronald Reagan addressed the National Association of Evangelicals in Orlando, Florida. He called the Soviet Union an “evil empire” and opposed a nuclear weapons freeze.
en.n: The location is the speech venue in the United States.

zh.t: 里根在奥兰多发表“邪恶帝国”演说
zh.s: 1983年3月8日，美国总统罗纳德·里根在佛罗里达州奥兰多向全国福音派协会发表演说。他将苏联称为“邪恶帝国”，并反对冻结核武器的提议。
zh.n: 地点标注的是美国境内的演讲地点。

en.s: On 8 March 1985, a car bomb exploded between 9 and 45 metres from the house of Shia cleric Sayyed Mohammad Hussein Fadlallah in Beirut, Lebanon, in a failed assassination attempt by a Lebanese counter-terrorism unit linked to the Central Intelligence Agency. The bombing killed up to 80 people and injured up to 200. Beirut experienced three other deadly car bombs in the following months, this time targeting Christian areas.

zh.s: 1985年3月8日，一枚汽车炸弹在黎巴嫩贝鲁特什叶派教士赛义德·穆罕默德·侯赛因·法德拉拉住所外9至45米处爆炸。这是一个与美国中央情报局有联系的黎巴嫩反恐单位发动的暗杀行动，但未能杀死目标。爆炸造成多达80人死亡、200人受伤。在随后几个月里，贝鲁特又发生三起致命汽车炸弹袭击，这次目标是基督徒聚居区。

en.s: Operation Karbala-7 (Arabic: عملیات كربلاء ۷) was an Iranian offensive in Haj Omran during the Iran–Iraq War to prevent Iraq from rapidly transferring units to its defense lines at Basra after Iran had launched the failed Operation Karbala-5 to capture the city of Basra. This was a failed Iranian attempt to reoccupy the summit of Kurda Mand Mountain.

zh.s: 卡尔巴拉-7行动是两伊战争期间伊朗在哈杰·奥姆兰发动的一次攻势，目的是阻止伊拉克在伊朗发动失败的卡尔巴拉-5行动、试图攻占巴士拉后，迅速调兵加固巴士拉防线。伊朗试图重新占领库尔达曼山顶，但未能成功。

en.s: A presidential primary was held in the U.S. state of Alabama on March 8, 1988, to elect delegates representing Alabama to the 1988 Democratic National Convention. Alabama was allocated sixty-five delegates, fifty-six of which were pledged. Thirty-seven delegates were elected from the seven congressional districts and the remaining nineteen were chosen by the State Democratic Executive Committee to reflect candidates' statewide vote totals.

zh.t: 1988年阿拉巴马州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 1988年3月8日，美国阿拉巴马州举行民主党总统初选，选出代表该州参加1988年民主党全国代表大会的代表。该州共有65个代表名额，其中56名代表须按分配结果支持指定候选人。37名代表由七个国会选区选出，其余19名由州民主党执行委员会根据各候选人的全州得票情况选定。

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 3739 was a Soviet domestic passenger flight from Irkutsk to Leningrad (now Saint Petersburg) with a stopover in Kurgan. On 8 March 1988, after the Tupolev Tu-154 operating the flight had left Kurgan, it was hijacked by the Ovechkin family, whose members sought to defect from the Soviet Union. The Ovechkin family demanded the crew fly the aircraft to London.

zh.t: 苏联民航3739号班机劫持事件（1988年）
zh.s: 苏联民航3739号班机是从伊尔库茨克飞往列宁格勒（今圣彼得堡）的苏联国内航班，中途停靠库尔干。1988年3月8日，图-154客机从库尔干起飞后，奥维奇金一家劫持了飞机，企图叛逃苏联。他们要求机组人员将飞机飞往伦敦。

en.t: 1988 São Tomé and Príncipe coup attempt
en.s: The 1988 São Tomé and Príncipe coup attempt was a failed paramilitary operation undertaken by the exile National Resistance Front of São Tomé and Príncipe – Renewal (Portuguese: Frente de Resistência Nacional de São Tomé and Príncipe – Renovada FRNSTP-R) that sought to overthrow the ruling MLSTP government.

zh.s: 1988年圣多美和普林西比未遂政变是一次失败的准军事行动，由流亡海外的圣多美和普林西比民族抵抗阵线—革新派（葡萄牙语：Frente de Resistência Nacional de São Tomé and Príncipe – Renovada，FRNSTP-R）发起，目标是推翻执政的圣多美和普林西比解放运动政府。

He was challenged by attorney Jim Lewis and landlord Angelo Diamond, which initially scheduled the election for February 8 and a general election, if needed, for March 8.

zh.s: 1994年劳德代尔堡市长选举于3月8日举行。1991年首次当选的现任市长吉姆·诺格尔竞逐第二个任期，挑战者是律师吉姆·刘易斯和房东安杰洛·戴蒙德。投票最初定于2月8日举行，如有需要，再于3月8日举行正式选举。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 8 March 1994. They were won by the governing Antigua Labour Party under the leadership of Lester Bird. Bird had been appointed leader of the ALP before the elections, after his father and predecessor Vere Bird announced his intention to retire. Lester Bird became Prime Minister after elections. Voter turnout was 62.3%.

zh.s: 安提瓜和巴布达于1994年3月8日举行大选，莱斯特·伯德领导的执政党安提瓜工党获胜。选前，他的父亲兼前任党魁维尔·伯德宣布准备退休，莱斯特随后获任工党领袖，并在选后出任总理。此次投票率为62.3%。

en.s: On 8 March 1994, a Sahara India Airlines Boeing 737-200 crashed shortly after takeoff during a training exercise at Delhi-Indira Gandhi International Airport, India. The plane crashed into an Aeroflot Ilyushin Il-86, which led to both aircraft being destroyed. All 6 crew members on both aircraft were killed, along with two other Aeroflot employees on the Ilyushin, while one person on the ground was killed.

zh.t: 1994年英迪拉·甘地国际机场飞机相撞事故
zh.s: 1994年3月8日，印度萨哈拉航空一架波音737-200客机在新德里英迪拉·甘地国际机场进行训练飞行时，起飞后不久坠毁，并撞上俄罗斯民航一架伊尔-86客机，两架飞机均被毁。两机共12名机组人员和伊尔-86上的另外两名俄罗斯民航员工全部遇难，地面另有一人死亡。

en.s: Space Shuttle Discovery (Orbiter Vehicle Designation: OV-103) is a retired American Space Shuttle orbiter. The spaceplane was one of the orbiters from NASA's Space Shuttle program and the third of five fully operational orbiters to be built. Its first mission, STS-41-D, flew from August 30 to September 5, 1984. Over 27 years of service it launched and landed 39 times, aggregating more spaceflights than any other spacecraft as of December 2024.
en.n: Space Shuttle Discovery launches on STS-102, carrying the Expedition 2 crew to the International Space Station.

zh.t: 发现号航天飞机执行STS-102任务
zh.s: 发现号航天飞机（轨道器编号：OV-103）是已退役的美国航天飞机轨道器，曾参与NASA航天飞机计划，也是五架正式投入使用的轨道器中第三架建成的飞船。它的首次任务STS-41-D于1984年8月30日至9月5日执行。在27年服役期间，它共发射和着陆39次；截至2024年12月，它执行的太空飞行次数超过任何其他航天器。
zh.n: 发现号航天飞机执行STS-102任务，将远征2号乘组送往国际空间站。

en.t: Iraqi Governing Council signs the transitional constitution
en.s: On March 8, 2004, the Iraqi Governing Council signed the Transitional Administrative Law, Iraq’s provisional constitution following the 2003 invasion. The law came into effect on June 28, 2004.
en.n: This records the signing, not the law’s entry into force or the 2005 referendum on the permanent constitution.

zh.t: 伊拉克临时管理委员会签署过渡宪法
zh.s: 2004年3月8日，伊拉克临时管理委员会签署《过渡时期国家管理法》，作为2003年伊拉克战争后的临时宪法。这部法律于2004年6月28日生效。
zh.n: 此处记录签署日期，并非法律生效或2005年永久宪法公投的日期。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Federated States of Micronesia on 8 March 2005, alongside a three-part referendum. As no political parties existed, all 23 candidates for the 10 available seats in Congress ran as Independents. In the referendums voters were asked whether they approved of three proposed amendments to the constitution. These would remove the power of the Supreme Court to rule on land and water issues, give the states credit for their acts, and lift the ban on dual citizenship. The proposed amendments required a 75% majority in at least three of the four states.

zh.t: 2005年密克罗尼西亚联邦议会选举
zh.s: 密克罗尼西亚联邦于2005年3月8日举行议会选举，同时就三项议题举行公投。由于国内没有政党，争夺国会10个席位的23名候选人均以独立人士身份参选。公投询问选民是否赞成三项修宪提案：取消最高法院裁决土地和水域问题的权力，承认各州行为的效力，以及解除双重国籍禁令。提案需要在四个州中的至少三个州获得75%的支持才能通过。

en.s: On March 8, 2005, a special election was held in the California's 5th congressional district to choose a U.S. Representative to replace Bob Matsui, who had died of pneumonia shortly after being re-elected in the 2004 elections. Matsui's wife, Doris, was quickly able to win support from the Democratic Party officials, and ended up winning over two-thirds of the vote in the special primary election, meaning a run-off would not be needed.

zh.t: 2005年加利福尼亚州第5国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 2005年3月8日，加利福尼亚州第5国会选区举行特别选举，补选美国众议员鲍勃·松井去世后留下的空缺。松井在2004年选举中连任后不久因肺炎去世。他的妻子多丽丝很快获得民主党官员的支持，最终在特别初选中赢得超过三分之二的选票，因此无需举行决选。

en.s: The 2005 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on March 8, 2005, with a run-off election on May 17, 2005. In a rematch of the 2001 election, Councilman Antonio Villaraigosa defeated the sitting mayor, James Hahn, becoming the city's first Hispanic mayor since the 19th century. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 2005年3月8日，洛杉矶举行市长选举，5月17日进行第二轮投票。这是2001年选举的重赛，市议员安东尼奥·维拉莱戈萨击败现任市长詹姆斯·哈恩，成为该市自19世纪以来首位西班牙裔市长。加利福尼亚州市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）依法不设党派，候选人的党派不会出现在选票上。

en.s: The 2008 Sabah state election was held on Saturday, 8 March 2008, simultaneously with the 12th general election of Malaysia. 60 state assembly seats were contested. The election was won by the Barisan Nasional (BN) coalition with a similar amount of seats won as in the previous election, where they won 59 seats. One seat was won by Democratic Action Party (DAP). In the previous election, BN won 59 seats, while one seat was won by an independent candidate. Other parties contesting in this election are Democratic Action Party, Parti Keadilan Rakyat, BERSEKUTU, Pasok, Setia, and 47 independent candidates.

zh.s: 2008年沙巴州选举于3月8日星期六举行，与马来西亚第12届全国大选同日进行，改选州议会全部60席。国民阵线赢得59席，获胜席位数与上届相同；民主行动党赢得1席。上届选举的另外1席由独立候选人取得。除国民阵线外，参加此次选举的还有民主行动党、人民公正党、沙巴人民团结党（BERSEKUTU）、沙巴原住民团结党（Pasok）、沙巴人民力量党（Setia），以及47名独立候选人。

en.s: A general election was held on Saturday, 8 March 2008 for members of the 12th Parliament of Malaysia. Voting took place in all 222 parliamentary constituencies of Malaysia, each electing one Member of Parliament to the Dewan Rakyat, the dominant house of Parliament. State elections also took place in 505 state constituencies in 12 out of 13 states (excluding Sarawak) on the same day. The 12th Parliament was dissolved on 13 February 2008, and the following day, the Election Commission announced nominations would be held on 24 February, with general polling set for 8 March.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in the Federated States of Micronesia on 8 March 2011, alongside a three-part referendum. en.t: Twenty-eight political institutions in Myanmar establish the National Unity Consultative Council, a historic alliance of ethnic armed organizations and democratically elected leaders, in response to the 2021 Myanmar coup d'état
en.s: The National Unity Consultative Council (Burmese: အမျိုးသားညီညွတ်ရေးအတိုင်ပင်ခံကောင်စီ; NUCC) is an advisory body of the National Unity Government of Myanmar. Formed in response to the 2021 Myanmar coup d'etat, the NUCC seeks to overthrow the military dictatorship and build a federal democratic union in Myanmar through collective leadership, political dialogue, and coordination. zh.s: 缅甸民族团结协商委员会（缅甸语：အမျိုးသားညီညွတ်ရေးအတိုင်ပင်ခံကောင်စီ；NUCC）是缅甸民族团结政府的咨询机构。该委员会为回应2021年缅甸政变而成立，致力于通过集体领导、政治对话和协调推翻军政府，并在缅甸建立联邦民主联盟。它是由民族武装组织和缅族多数群体组成的重要联盟，被视为缅甸现代史上包容性较强的联盟之一。

en.s: The 2025 Western Australian state election was held on 8 March 2025 to elect members to the Parliament of Western Australia, where all 59 seats in the Legislative Assembly and all 37 seats in the Legislative Council were up for election. en.s: The 2026 Baden-Württemberg state election was held on 8 March 2026. The outgoing government was a coalition of Alliance 90/The Greens supported by the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) led by Minister-President Winfried Kretschmann (Greens), who retired at this election. Defying most polls leading up to the election, the Greens remained the largest party with 30.2% of the vote, only a small decline from the previous election.

zh.s: 2026年巴登-符腾堡州选举于3月8日举行。选前政府由联盟90/绿党与基督教民主联盟联合执政，州长为绿党的温弗里德·克雷奇曼，他在此次选举时退休。结果与选前大多数民调的预测不同，绿党仍以30.2%的得票率保持第一大党地位，较上次选举仅小幅下降。
